description.value: Armstrong Regional Co-op is a member-owned cooperative founded in 1922 by the townspeople of Armstrong and Spallumcheen, making it one of the oldest co-ops in the Okanagan. It operates gas bar and convenience locations, bulk fuel services, and an associated liquor store (ARC Liquor). For touring cyclists it offers a one-stop roadside convenience stop with snacks, drinks, and fuel in the North Okanagan.
